name: module-flag-honour-registry
body: `honours_module_flag` is a static registry of the ids the driver ships, so it cannot know a frontend's installed state or a future frontend's real capability and the refusal fires only for an id the driver does not ship; upgrade when a shipped frontend genuinely cannot apply `--module` (have it report the capability) or a non-CLI caller passes an unvalidated language id with a module selection.
